<reason>B (PRO) won the debate's two decisive clashes. First, on the motion's core distinction: A's network/atomization argument claimed role-specific reasons are impossible because presence is interdependent, but B showed interdependence is articulable as bounded, schedulable, falsifiable claims ("who needs whom, when, for what") — distinct from broad culture assertions in exactly the way the motion requires. A's counter ("that's culture with a calendar") redefined all interdependence as culture and overclaimed concession. Second, on A's strong arbiter fork: B answered Q1 directly with a layered mechanism (bargaining, existing accommodation review, courts as backstop) plus two arbiter-independent benefits — internal schedule discipline and a written record making pretext provable ("exposed when no juniors are in the building"). A's "strip current law and the motion adds the memo" only partly engaged that evidentiary-upgrade mechanism, and the padded five-day mandate point was asserted to "pass untouched" without explaining why the mandate-to-reasons gap isn't contestable. A was rhetorically superb ("only one pays childcare," the migration critique) and pressed the futility fork hard, but B stayed closer to the motion as written, answered both pressure questions more completely, and left more live routes standing: burden asymmetry was barely contested, and A's market alternative tests a mandate's price after exit, not its justification before harm, for the least-leveraged workers the motion targets. Clean format compliance and epistemic discipline on both sides.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>The orchestra/violinist exchange decided the motion's definitional core: A opened with the orchestra to prove role-specific justification impossible for network goods; B flipped it (the violinist says "timing, tuning, taking cues," never "culture") and held the flip through three rounds as "choreography, not fog," while A's rebuttals increasingly relied on redefining any relational reason as culture. Runner-up: B's A1 layered-arbiter answer to A's enforcement fork, which defused the futility horn by giving the memo standalone evidentiary and internal-discipline value.</best_rebuttal>
